svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · Meridian › Appearance reorganized · Application Style takes the materials from Colors · icon sets · accepted neutral surfaces, 8/12 radii, Inter
Appearance · how apps are drawn; Colors keeps mode and accent
Let panels and the taskbar show the background
Diffuse what shows through; text stays on solid ground
Extend materials to app canvases, not only panels
Moved here from Colors: materials are about how surfaces are drawn, not which colors they use.
One Apply covers Colors and Application Style, as today; nothing about the saved choices changes.
Transparency 40 %, blur on, whole app off:
the window frame and taskbar are
materials; the app canvas stays solid.
Materials change how surfaces are drawn. Colors keeps mode and accent, so its page is about color only.
Which sounds play is an output setting, next to the devices and app volumes that play them.
Login Screen only chooses how the greeter looks. Who may skip it is an administrator policy.
Every boot style keeps the log and rescue entry. Whether they show is a system setting, not a style.

Groups: Colors & Themes (Colors, Application Style, Window Decorations, Icons, Cursors) · Startup & Login (Session Splash, Login Screen, Boot Splash) · Text & Fonts. Wallpaper and Animations stay direct pages.
Light · Icons: the default set first, other sets shown with what they would need
Appearance › Colors & Themes · one set for the desktop, the taskbar and every app
Default · outline, 2 px strokes, round joins · from Lucide (ISC) · 61 icons in zenith-icons
Proposed · the same drawings at 2.5 px for low-DPI screens and readability
Proposed · 1.5 px strokes for large scales (150 % and up)
Other sets checked for Zenith (licence, coverage of the 61 names, outline style that fits Inter):
MIT · 5 000+ outline icons, 2 px on 24 px: closest match; names to be mapped one by one
MIT · six weights (thin to fill) in one family: one set could supply Fine, Zenith and Bold
Apache-2.0 · line and fill pairs; more geometric, fewer system roles
Apache-2.0 · variable weight and fill; a different visual language from Inter
An app asks for a name the set lacks:
a dashed tile with its initial, never blank,
and the name is logged once.
zenith-icons. Choosing one is a personal setting;
the login screen keeps the default.
Requires: a set name in the personal appearance record, icon lookup by set in the toolkit and the desktop (64-file package limit: sets ship as their own packages). Values are illustrative.
